_about: Scarlet's agent directory: what each agent handles and the exact task it accepts. This is KNOWLEDGE, not permission: who Scarlet may hand work to is set only in her policy (scarlet/policy.ts). Changes go through a reviewed PR.

agents.name: GTM Signal Router
agents.handles: New product signups that need routing to sales, nurture or self-serve.
agents.idFormat: Signup ids are lowercase words joined by hyphens, like harbor-health or quickship-labs. A request that names one is complete.

examples.action: delegate with task: Route this new signup. signup_id: harbor-health
signup_id is missing: report_friction (missing_data), then ask_human which signup

agents.name: JML Agent
agents.handles: HR events on the identity layer: joiners (create account), movers (change team), leavers (disable, revoke sessions, move to JML-Terminated). Every change waits for Will's approval.
agents.idFormat: HR event ids look like hr-1001: the letters hr, a hyphen and four digits. A request that names one is complete.

examples.action: delegate with task: Process HR event. event_id: hr-1001
no event id: report_friction (missing_data), then ask_human which HR event
